<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui/pull/3820):

>## Summary
>
>The default `imageStorage` of 50Gi causes the `assisted-image-service` pod to crash with `no space left on device` when `AgentServiceConfig` is created without an `osImages` filter.
>
>Without `osImages`, the operator downloads RHCOS ISOs for all 4 architectures (x86_64, arm64, s390x, ppc64le) across all supported OCP versions (4.9 through 5.0), currently 47 ISOs totaling ~47GB. The `default_os_images.json` list has grown over time (OCP 5.0 images added April 2026, continuous version bumps), making 50Gi no longer sufficient.
>
>## Changes
>
>- Raise default `imageStorage` from 50Gi to 100Gi (`CimConfigurationModal.tsx`)
>- Raise `MIN_IMG_VOL_SIZE` from 10Gi to 50Gi (`constants.ts`)
>- Update recommendation text from "50Gi or more" to "100Gi or more" (`CimConfigurationFormFields.tsx`)
>- Update validation error message to reflect new minimum (`CimConfigurationModal.tsx`)
>
>## Reproduced on
>
>- OCP 4.22.3 on vSphere with MCE 2.17.0
>- OCP 4.22.2 on baremetal IPI with MCE 2.17.0
>
>## Longer-term improvements
>
>Tracked in OCPBUGS-97734:
>
>- Allow configuring `osImages` filter from the UI during initial AgentServiceConfig creation
>- Operator-side: detect hub architecture and default to current + previous two EUS versions instead of downloading all versions for all architectures
>- On-demand ISO download instead of all-at-startup
>
>Bug: https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/OCPBUGS-97734
